title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Bounce Book. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Bounce Book
options.lineage: Indian cheque leaf, bank passbook, MICR print
options.thesis: The failed-payment engine wears the artifact failure was printed on: an open bank passbook where every rupee has a row and the red bounce stamp is the system's most honest citizen.
options.viewport: An open passbook spread: index tabs as navigation, KPIs as a statement summary box, the batch simulator as a perforated recovery voucher stamped on execution.

raised.raise: State law: every recovery state maps to exactly one stamp ink — green PAID, red STOPPED, amber PROMISED, ink-blue pending — never a gradient, never ambiguous.
Motion law: one timing for the whole book — every stamp slams with a single 0.4s overshoot and settles, nothing else animates.
Spine law: every ledger row reads whole from its margin — amount, stamp, clause — before any expansion.

options.risk: Reads nostalgic-quirky if the stamps become stickers and the grid goes soft; it only works at full bank-document severity.

options.label: Mission Control, Sriharikota
options.thesis: The recovery engine as a countdown: every intervention a scheduled burn, guardrails as range-safety red lines no one crosses.
options.viewport: A console wall: bank-health telemetry live on phosphor screens, the pipeline running as a launch sequence with countdown discipline.
options.risk: Mission control is the default dramatic grammar for autonomous systems — every judge has seen a launch-console demo, and it shares the dark canvas with the incumbent.

options.label: The Signal Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscope on a signal bench
options.thesis: Payment events as live traces: the pipeline overlays one measured graticule, the guardrail is a trigger level you can see.
options.viewport: One screen, many signals: AI strategy and naive baseline as two channels on the same ten-division grid.
options.case: Fuses cleanly — event streams as traces, trigger level as the compliance threshold; loses narrowly on rupee, stamp and settlement semantics.
options.risk: Collapses into Bloomberg-terminal monoculture if the graticule loses its ten-division law.

options.label: The Mesophotic Descent
options.lineage: technical deep-dive down a reef wall
options.thesis: The pipeline as a staged descent: detect at the surface, cross the guardrail thermocline, settle on the audit floor.
options.viewport: One vertical depth axis ruling every line of copy; the thermocline band marks where hard stops live.
options.case: The depth axis sequences the pipeline beautifully, but Indian payments judges do not live underwater.
options.risk: Marine metaphor overpowers the compliance story if the depth axis does not carry real data.

options.label: Four-Green Field
options.case: Fuses weakly: four shades cannot carry rupee tables, Hinglish chat and LLM reasoning.
options.kept: State law: one ink per state, never ambiguity — the stamp inks are now strict.

options.label: Coastline Map
options.case: Fuses poorly: ledger space is tabular, not lobular, and judges do not identify with zoo maps.
options.kept: Motion law: everything that moves takes 0.4s and overshoots before settling — the stamp slam inherits it.

options.label: Archive Wall
options.lineage: stacked sneaker boxes with printed end labels
options.case: Fuses weakly: hinge-and-lid browsing fits a catalog, not a live ledger; consumer archive culture is not the judges' world.
options.kept: Spine law: every container reads whole from its labeled edge before opening — ledger rows inherit the margin.

canonCard.label: The Category Standard
canonCard.thesis: The polished fintech dashboard this category always ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sticky nav, KPI cards, a dense table — the arrangement every judge expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other payments demo by design.
